thread:
sanjay: Heads-up — planning a gated deploy wave tonight 23:00 UTC. runtime -> v2.4.0, api -> v1.9.1, console -> v3.2.0, router unchanged. Need agreement on canary slices, variant pin, and rollback thresholds.
amanda: SGTM. What are the canary percentages and durations?
kevin: Also we should decide if runtime uses the quantized variant; last rollout had transient mem spikes.
sanjay: Proposal: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then rolling to 100%. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > baseline * 1.3 OR any OOM/eviction.
jen_ops: +1 to those triggers. Add GC spike >2% as a soft abort (manual review).
sanjay: We'll pin runtime to the quantized variant tag: runtime:qv2 for the wave. That avoids the unpredictable float path that caused the mem spike.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by @sanjay: runtime:v2.4.0 (runtime:qv2) -> api:v1.9.1 -> console:v3.2.0. Canary plan: 5% / 15m -> 25% / 30m -> 100% rolling. Rollback conditions included in the job metadata.
amanda: Release notes draft (short): "runtime: improved continuous batching and KV-cache resilience; api: header-based region steering; console: telemetry UI cleanup and expanded logs." I'll paste to #release-notes.
matt: Ops runbook for manual rollback (keeps it short):
```
1) /rollout set traffic runtime canary 0
2) /config set runtime image v2.3.9
3) /orchestrator pin runtime tag runtime:v2.3.9
4) flip console to maintenance mode and notify customers
``` 
kevin: Add a quick canary smoke: `curl -H 'x-test: canary' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/health` and check p95 via /metrics histo.
sanjay: Doing a dry-run at 22:45 UTC (15m before window) to validate locks and config sync. Deploy-bot will post preflight results.
deploy-bot: dry-run complete: preflight OK — config locks, schema-compat, routing rules, and variant availability all green. Ready for change window.
jen_ops: I'll be on-call from 22:30 to 01:00. I'll silence non-critical alerts and watch for GC/evictions and router errors.
amanda: I'll update the changelog and push the short blurb to #release-notes and the customer-facing doc.
sanjay: Final ack from owners before go-time?
kevin: ack.
amanda: ack.
jen_ops: ack.
sanjay: Thanks — proceeding with the window unless anyone raises a blocker in the next 10m."
